question: According to Census 2011, which of the following districts has the least sex ratio?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Daman**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• As per the **Census 2011**, **Daman**, a district in the union territory of **Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu**, has the **lowest sex ratio in India**.
 
• The sex ratio of **Daman** is **591 females per 1000 males**, which is significantly lower compared to other regions in the country.
 
• The low sex ratio in Daman is primarily attributed to **migrant male laborers** who constitute a significant proportion of the population, leading to a gender imbalance.
 
• Other districts mentioned in the options, such as **Surat, Kargil,** and **Chandigarh**, have comparatively better sex ratios than Daman.
 
• The sex ratio is a critical demographic indicator that reflects the number of females per 1000 males and is used to assess gender equity in society.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sex Ratio in Census 2011:**

 
 
• The **sex ratio** in India as per the **2011 Census** is **940 females per 1000 males**.
 
• Kerala has the **highest sex ratio** of **1084 females per 1000 males**, while Haryana has one of the lowest among states with **879 females per 1000 males**.
 
 
 
• **Factors Influencing Low Sex Ratio in Daman:**
 
 
• **Migrant Workforce:** A large influx of male migrant workers in industries and factories has skewed the demographic balance.
 
• **Patriarchal Norms:** Cultural preferences for male children in some regions contribute to gender imbalances.
 
 
 
• **Sex Ratio in Other Districts:**
 
 
• **Surat:** The sex ratio in Surat, Gujarat, is approximately **774 females per 1000 males**, primarily due to the high number of male migrant laborers.
 
• **Kargil:** Kargil, in the union territory of Ladakh, has a **sex ratio of 810 females per 1000 males**, which is higher than Daman.
 
• **Chandigarh:** The union territory of Chandigarh has a sex ratio of **818 females per 1000 males**, higher than Daman but still lower than the national average.
 
 
 
• **Importance of Sex Ratio:**
 
 
• The sex ratio is an important social indicator that reflects the status of women in society.
 
• A skewed sex ratio can lead to social issues, such as **gender discrimination**, **imbalanced marriage markets**, and **increased crime rates** against women.
 
 
 
• **Government Initiatives to Improve Sex Ratio:**
 
 
• **Beti Bachao Beti Padhao Scheme:** Launched in 2015, this scheme aims to address the declining child sex ratio and promote education for girls.
 
• **Pre-Conception and Pre-Natal Diagnostic Techniques (PCPNDT) Act, 1994:** Enacted to prevent sex-selective abortions and regulate prenatal diagnostic techniques.
